cause_quote: The new `prepareCronRunAdmission` call passed `scheduledToolPolicy: request.scheduledToolPolicy`, and admission stored it as `policy: scheduledToolPolicy`, leaving the recorded creator origin out of the message grant.
user_saw: An account-owned scheduled script could fail with “Scheduled telegram:delete requires matching recorded creator origin” even when the job had a matching recorded origin.
summary: Scheduled script message admission now uses the creator-origin policy resolved during runtime preparation, while Telegram still enforces its separate conversation-binding check.
reasoning: The parent of #159873 used generic run admission and issued no scheduled message capability for the script. I checked that the creator-origin check already existed when #159873 introduced the script’s message grant with an origin-free policy. #176158 later restored the origin during preparation and included it in the cache key, but admission still used the original request policy.
